player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aʋa ŋu ŋlɔɖi na '[source] [target]' ɖe ŋutɔ.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Èyɔ afisi wòtso alo mɔ̃ si dzi wòle be woato la nazu dzodzro.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Èdze agbagba be yeakplɔ nuɖegbalẽvi aɖe tso xɔ si me naneke mele o la dzi.
invalid_move.same_tower: Èdze agbagba be yeatsɔ disk la ayii ɖe mɔ̃a dzi.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Èdze agbagba be yeatsɔ agba gã aɖe aɖo ɖe esi le sue wu dzi.

outcome.win: Makafu wò! Èkpɔ Hanoi-mɔ̃a ƒe nya ɣaɣla gbɔ.
outcome.turn_limit: Woɖo fli siwo le mɔa dzi la ƒe {pct}% ɖe Kpeƒe C.
